4th Period.weeklyDeliverable: ROLLER mod v2 pushed to your repo by Sunday night: 1 bug report + 1 feature request filed as GitHub Issues on your partner's repo, your own bug fixed and your partner's feature request built (or scoped down with a written reason), both signed off by your partner, and a v1 → v2 changelog on your portfolio site.

4th Period.smartGoal: I can turn a feature request into a design spec and build it (or a scoped-down version) in the right JavaScript file, so it passes my partner's success test by Friday.

4th Period.connections: Tuesday you fixed a bug and triaged a feature request. Today your partner checks the fix — and checks that nothing else broke — before you build something new, because that is the order real teams work in. Tomorrow your partner tests the feature, and you ship v2.
